title: The `--prog-n` and `--prog-f` errors name a `--prog-seed` flag that does not exist
body:
`SearchArgs::validate` (nail/src/args.rs) rejects `--prog-n` and `--prog-f` under static seeding with `the argument '--prog-n' cannot be used without '--prog-seed'`. nail has no `--prog-seed` flag. Progressive seeding is `--seed-mode prog`.

## Proposal

Both messages name `--seed-mode prog`.
close_reason: Both messages in SearchArgs::validate now name --seed-mode prog. Committed on dev.
